title: Jesus Wants Me for a Sunbeam
description: Jesus Wants Me for a Sunbeam in Tonic Solfa to SUNBEAM: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the 4 verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: Nellie Talbot (Ellen Alice Talbot, 1861–1950), a Sunday school worker in Portsmouth, England, wrote the words after a Sunday school convention in 1898; they were in print by 1900. Edwin O. Excell wrote the tune SUNBEAM in 1900.
underlay: Je-sus wants me for a sun-beam, To shine for Him each day; In eve-ry way try to please Him, At home, at school, at play. A sun-beam, a sun-beam, Je-sus wants me for a sun-beam; A sun-beam, a sun-beam, I’ll be a sun-beam for Him.

lines: Jesus wants me for a sunbeam,
To shine for Him each day;
In every way try to please Him,
At home, at school, at play.

verses.label: Refrain
lines: A sunbeam, a sunbeam,
Jesus wants me for a sunbeam;
A sunbeam, a sunbeam,
I’ll be a sunbeam for Him.
Jesus wants me to be loving,
And kind to all I see;
Showing how pleasant and happy,
His little one can be.
I will ask Jesus to help me
To keep my heart from sin;
Ever reflecting His goodness,
And always shine for Him.
I’ll be a sunbeam for Jesus,
I can if I but try;
Serving Him moment by moment,
Then live for Him on high.
